# Captain Saul

## Overview

- **Age:** Aged  <sub>[v4 c6 P0](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0000), [v4 c6 P14](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0014), [v4 c9 P51](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0051), [v4 c17 P29](../source/v04-c17.md#nw-v04-c17-p0029)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v4 c6 P8](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0008), [v4 c6 P14](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0014), [v4 c17 P20](../source/v04-c17.md#nw-v04-c17-p0020)</sub>
- **Status:** Deceased  <sub>[v5 c2 P68](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0068)</sub>
- **Role:** Former sea captain, lighthouse keeper, and fisherman  <sub>[v4 c6 P8](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0008), [v4 c6 P14](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0014), [v4 c24 P35](../source/v04-c24.md#nw-v04-c24-p0035), [v5 c2 P68](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0068)</sub>
- **Titles:** Captain  <sub>[v4 c6 P8](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0008), [v4 c24 P33](../source/v04-c24.md#nw-v04-c24-p0033)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Captain Saul  <sub>[v4 c6 P10](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0010)</sub>; Uncle Saul  <sub>[v4 c24 P35](../source/v04-c24.md#nw-v04-c24-p0035)</sub>

## Appearance

He is a tall, plain-looking, and somewhat stooped elderly man who nevertheless conveys immense endurance and strength. He has thick, iron-gray hair that falls to his shoulders alongside a bronzed, deeply lined, clean-shaved face. His deep-set blue eyes alternate between twinkling, dreaming, and looking searchingly toward the sea.

_Sources: [v4 c6 P14](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0014), [v4 c6 P15](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0015)_

## Personality

Captain Saul is a warm, courageous, and optimistic man with an unyielding good humor. He maintains an adventurous spirit and a deep love for storytelling, possessing a natural ability to captivate listeners with his past maritime exploits. He displays high principles, deep chivalry, and utmost respect toward women, refusing to permit disparaging remarks about them in his presence.

_Sources: [v4 c6 P10](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0010), [v4 c6 P14](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0014), [v4 c9 P48](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0048), [v4 c9 P49](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0049), [v4 c9 P59](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0059), [v4 c17 P17](../source/v04-c17.md#nw-v04-c17-p0017), [v4 c17 P18](../source/v04-c17.md#nw-v04-c17-p0018)_

## Goals

- To preserve the memory of his sea adventures for his nephew Joe  <sub>[v4 c17 P20](../source/v04-c17.md#nw-v04-c17-p0020), [v4 c24 P35](../source/v04-c24.md#nw-v04-c24-p0035)</sub>

## History

Captain Saul served for decades as a mariner before settling at the Seven Gulls light as keeper. Upon the arrival of Dr. Hugh Carrow and his wife Nell, he welcomed them to Seven Gulls, bringing them fresh trout and quickly forming a close friendship with both. He regularly entertained them with recounting accounts of his seafaring days and showed Nell his handwritten life-book, which recorded his ocean voyages for his nephew Joe. When author Adrian Treleaven visited, Nell introduced him to Captain Saul and his logbook. Inspired by the old captain's extensive experiences, Treleaven utilized material from Captain Saul's life-book to author a successful biographical work titled The Life Book. Captain Saul later passed away in Seven Gulls.

_Sources: [v4 c6 P1](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0001), [v4 c6 P8](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0008), [v4 c6 P9](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0009), [v4 c9 P46](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0046), [v4 c9 P49](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0049), [v4 c17 P19](../source/v04-c17.md#nw-v04-c17-p0019), [v4 c17 P20](../source/v04-c17.md#nw-v04-c17-p0020), [v4 c24 P27](../source/v04-c24.md#nw-v04-c24-p0027), [v4 c24 P34](../source/v04-c24.md#nw-v04-c24-p0034), [v4 c24 P39](../source/v04-c24.md#nw-v04-c24-p0039), [v5 c2 P68](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0068), [v5 c2 P69](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0069)_

- Had a limited formal education  <sub>[v4 c24 P35](../source/v04-c24.md#nw-v04-c24-p0035)</sub>
- Spent a lifetime navigating the seas and surviving shipwrecks, pirate attacks, and fires  <sub>[v4 c24 P30](../source/v04-c24.md#nw-v04-c24-p0030)</sub>
